notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.content:
v Beta 0.6
[b][DungeonPedia][/b] DungeonPedia offers now beautiful designed History articles. Also allows video content.
[b][Combat] [/b]Fixed Hit enemy animation when doing a power attack.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.content:
v Beta 0.5.2
[b] [New Feature - Throw Gold][/b] Player can Throw his own Gold to distract/control enemies.
[b] [Gameplay][/b] Improved Tutorial.
[b] [SFX][/b] Improved ingame overall SFX.
[b] [BugFixing][/b] Fixed  a bunch of small bugs.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.content:
v Bta 0.5.1
[b][Localization]  [/b] Korean Language added!
[b][Steam User BUG] [/b] Player was grappled even standing under an enemy and jumping trying to attack. 
[b][Improvement] [/b] Adjusted enemy hitboxes for more accurate and satisfying hits.
[b][Improvement] [/b] DPS System: Hitting fast enemies will stun them.
[b][Gameplay] [/b] Bag can now store 4 Sacred Texts at Level 0
[b][Gameplay][/b]  Falling from a deadly height won't kill the player, but it will reduce their Faith to only 5 points.
[b][Gameplay] [/b] No more automatic gold! You must now interact with enemy corpses to collect their gold.
[b][BUG] [/b] Levels with Mountain Breach had a wrong starting Player position.

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.content:
v. Beta 0.5
[b] [Gameplay] [/b]  New Tower Tutorial explaining the Game Basics. 
[b] [Gameplay] [/b]  New improved  Level 1 Tutorial with faster loading time.
[b] [Gameplay][/b]   Faster interaction times for the DEMO/BETA.
[b] [UI]  [/b] What Happened? window with a recap for those skipping the Game Introduction at Jerusalem.
[b] [UI] [/b]  Now Pressing ESC in Jerusalem menus will take you BACK.
[b] [UI][/b]   Faster transition when entering the Library  (no more inspirational quotes)

notes.title: Beta Update!
notes.content:
[b][Bug] [/b] Fixed the that Player couldn't fire a torch in First Door Level.
[b][Feature][/b] Added more options in Game Settings.
[b][Audio] [/b]No AI Voices: For those that can't stand AI-generated voices.
[b][Audio][/b]  Subtitles: You can now hide subtitles if you want.
[b][Settings][/b] Head Bob option for players with Motion Sickness.
[b] [Controllers] [/b] Gamepad is no longer auto-detected, so players need to manually activate it in Game Settings.
[b][Controllers] [/b] Game now has support for AZERTY keyboards.
[b][STEAMDECK] [/b] When playing on a SteamDeck player can't change resolution or deactivate the GamePad.

notes.title: Beta Update!
